_comment: Surface repairs applied at build time. Each entry fixes a generation artefact — a truncated word followed by its completion, or a doubled word — NOT a wording choice. The rater's judgement and every score are untouched; the original is kept on the row as original_text. This file exists rather than an edit to lines.jsonl because the pack is regenerated from Postgres by ingest_mallard.py, which would silently undo an in-place fix. Matching is on exact text, so one entry repairs the canonical row, its linked duplicate and any preference pair carrying the same line.
